subject: Nexa Health onboarding — mutual action plan and timeline
messages:
From: Tom Baker <tom.baker@nexahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nexahealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T16:12:00Z
Subject: Kickoff + MAP request

Hi Irene —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We want to lock down a mutual action plan (MAP) and a concrete timeline so our internal stakeholders can approve the go-live window. High level priorities for us: PII scope, audit logging retention, and a phased rollout that limits production traffic to 10% for the first 30 days.

Can your team draft a first-pass MAP with milestone owners and dates? Preferably something we can review with our security and procurement teams by the end of next week. I'm including Elena (our PM) on the thread.

Also, please send any pre-reqs we need to clear from infra/network/security.

Thanks —
Tom
Director of Engineering, Nexa Health
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Tom Baker <tom.baker@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nexahealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T18:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Kickoff + MAP request

Tom —

Appreciate the clarity on scope. Attached is a first-pass MAP spreadsheet (Nexa_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short network/security checklist (network-requirements.pdf) for your infra team. Quick summary of the proposed MAP milestones below (we kept owners conservative to avoid handoff gaps):

- Week A (Apr 19–23): Project kickoff & SOW sign-off — Owner: Tom (Nexa) / Irene (Redwood) — Deliverable: Signed SOW, access list
- Week B (Apr 26–30): Security questionnaire & evidence — Owner: Elena (Nexa) / Marissa (Redwood CS) — Deliverable: Completed questionnaire + SOC2 attestation link
- Week C (May 3–7): Test environment provisioning & network validation — Owner: Marcus (Redwood SE) / Nexa infra — Deliverable: Test endpoints, firewall rules validated
- Week D (May 10–21): Integration testing & eval prompts — Owner: Nexa devs / Marcus — Deliverable: Regression test pass/fail log, sample prompt suite
- Week E (May 24–Jun 4): Staged production ramp (10% → 50%) — Owner: Marissa (Redwood CS) / Tom — Deliverable: Ramp metrics and rollback plan
- Week F (Jun 7–Jun 18): Full production go-live & post-launch monitoring — Owner: Marissa / Marcus — Deliverable: Go-live sign-off and 30-day support plan

Notes:
- We recommend a 2-week cadence for syncs (kickoff + weekly 30-minute standups during critical weeks).
- Preliminary pre-reqs are in the attached checklist — Marcus, can you expand the network doc with IPs and ports?
- I've added a column in the sheet for acceptance criteria and risk level.

Next steps: Marissa will own CS acceptance criteria and the rollout playbook; Marcus will own infra validation and test endpoint provisioning. If that ownership looks good to you, we can convert this sheet into a living MAP and share a single link.

Irene
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nexa_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), network-requirements.pdf (PDF)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nexahealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T09:10:00Z
Subject: RE: Kickoff + MAP request — CS acceptance & rollout playbook

All —

Thanks, Irene. I took the sheet and added CS-specific checkpoints and acceptance criteria. Key highlights:

- Acceptance gates before any production traffic: successful auth flow, sample logs visible in audit stream, and quality baseline (top-5 prompt pass rate >= 85%).
- Rollout plan: 10% split (week 1), 30% (week 2), 50% (week 3) with automated rollback to 10% if latency or error budget breaches defined thresholds.
- Escalation path: Primary CS lead (Marissa), Secondary (Irene), SE escalation to Marcus.

I've attached a short checklist in the MAP for the first two weeks (owner assignments and test cases). Marcus — can you confirm the expected timeline to provision the test cluster? I want to schedule our first acceptance verification the week of May 3.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: updated MAP (inline in shared drive link)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nexahealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T14:22:00Z
Subject: RE: Kickoff + MAP request — infra pre-reqs

Team —

Confirming infra pre-reqs and tentative provisioning windows:

- Test environment: I can provision a customer-isolated test endpoint by May 1 if we get the IP allowlist and cross-account VPN details by Apr 23.
- Network: we require the 3 IP ranges listed in network-requirements.pdf to be allowed, plus outbound 443 to our telemetry endpoints.
- Data handling: for PII scope, we recommend token-level redaction configured in the staging model; Marissa/CS to confirm acceptable redaction policy.
- Monitoring: we'll place a lightweight Prometheus scrape and forward logs to Nexa's Splunk instance (if on your side) — Elena, can you confirm Splunk ingestion detail?

Risks: If IPs/VPN are delayed beyond Apr 23, test cluster shifts to May 8 which delays Week C by one week.

I'll add the IP list to the shared drive and flag the network doc for versioning.

Marcus
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: network IP list (in Drive)
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Tom Baker <tom.baker@nexahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nexahealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-13T11:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Kickoff + MAP request — confirming owners & next sync

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Tom / Elena — can you confirm:
1) SOW approval by Apr 23 (Tom)
2) IP allowlist and VPN details to Marcus by Apr 23 (Elena)
3) Security questionnaire review done by Apr 30 (Elena / Marissa)

If those dates are green, we'll schedule the first working sync for Apr 26 (30 minutes) and I'll convert the sheet to a shared MAP with live columns for status and risks. I've added the HubSpot deal link in the sheet and will include the MAP link in the calendar invite.

If anything slips, flag here and we'll adjust the staging window.

Irene
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
